set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Helpers validate dimensions, nonnegativity, mass, and fixed/relaxed marginals.
- Evaluators independently compute linear, entropy, KL, GW, and FGW terms.
- Barycentric projection handles orientation and zero transported mass.
- Helpers accept result objects and raw plans.
- Analytic/permutation/scaling tests pass.
set.title: Add plan validation, objective, and barycentric-projection utilities
